# extrasteps

The goal of extrasteps is to provide additional steps for
[recipes](https://github.com/tidymodels/recipes). These steps are
located in this package because they don’t fit well in
[recipes](https://recipes.tidymodels.org/) or [any of
the](https://textrecipes.tidymodels.org/)
[extension](https://embed.tidymodels.org/)
[packages](https://themis.tidymodels.org/).

> \[!IMPORTANT\]  
> These steps work, but they are not tested as rigorously as the steps
> in tidymodels packages. Hence why they are in this package. Also note
> that steps can graduate from {extrasteps} to {recipes}, if they prove
> their worth.

## Installation

You can install the released version of extrasteps from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

install.packages("extrasteps")
```

And the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("EmilHvitfeldt/extrasteps")
```

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the extrasteps project is released with a [Contributor
Code of
Conduct](https://contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html).
By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## Datetime Steps

- [`step_time_event()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_time_event.md)
  : Indicate Recurrent Date Time Event
- [`step_difftime()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_difftime.md)
  : difftimearithmic Transformation
- [`step_date_after()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_date_after.md)
  : Time after Recurrent Date Time Event
- [`step_date_before()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_date_before.md)
  : Time before Recurrent Date Time Event
- [`step_date_nearest()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_date_nearest.md)
  : Time to Nearest Recurrent Date Time Event

## Normalization

- [`step_maxabs()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_maxabs.md)
  : Perform Max Abs Scaling
- [`step_minmax()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_minmax.md)
  : Perform Min Max Scaling
- [`step_robust()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_robust.md)
  : Perform Robust Scaling
- [`step_unit_normalize()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_unit_normalize.md)
  : Perform Unit Normalization

## Categorical Encoding

- [`step_encoding_binary()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_encoding_binary.md)
  : Perform binary encoding of factor variables
- [`step_encoding_frequency()`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/extrasteps/reference/step_encoding_frequency.md)
  : Perform frequency encoding
